items.prompt: At 4 o'clock the hour hand points to 4 and the minute hand points to 12. What kind of angle do the hands make?
hints: Think about 3 o'clock first. What angle is that?
4 o'clock is one hour after 3 o'clock.
Is the angle bigger or smaller than a right angle?
items.explanation: At 3 o'clock the angle is 90°. At 4 o'clock it is 120°, which is bigger than a right angle and less than a straight line, so it is obtuse.

options.why: An acute angle is smaller than a right angle. At 4 o'clock the angle is bigger than that.
The hands make a right angle at 3 o'clock, not 4 o'clock.
The hands make a straight line at 6 o'clock.

items.prompt: Two angles sit on a straight line. One angle is 65°. What is the size of the other angle in degrees?
hints: The two angles add up to 180°.
items.explanation: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°. 180 - 65 = 115°.

items.prompt: True or false: A right angle measures 90 degrees.
hints: It is the corner of a square.
A quarter of a full turn.
items.explanation: A right angle is a quarter turn, which is 90 degrees.

items.prompt: True or false: An angle of 120 degrees is an acute angle.
hints: Acute means smaller than a right angle.
It is bigger than a right angle.
items.explanation: Acute angles are less than 90 degrees. 120 degrees is more than 90, so it is obtuse.

items.prompt: True or false: At 3 o'clock the hands of a clock make a right angle.
hints: How many numbers apart are 12 and 3?
It is like the corner of a square.
items.explanation: The minute hand points to 12 and the hour hand to 3, a quarter of the clock face apart: 90 degrees.

items.prompt: True or false: An obtuse angle is smaller than a right angle.
hints: Acute angles are the small ones.
items.explanation: An obtuse angle is bigger than 90 degrees and less than 180 degrees.
